description: Search the products UK stores sell through Vouchernaut (flowers, gifts, hampers, candles, homeware and more): title, store, price, the price after the store's best discount code, honest price-history notes ("Down from", "Lowest in 90 days"), the same product at other stores, and a tracked link to buy. Each product has a `ref` ("<store>/<product>").

max_price.description: Most it should cost, in pounds

min_price.description: Least it should cost, in pounds

on_sale.description: Only products below the store's full price

query.description: What the shopper wants, e.g. "red roses", "birthday hamper"

sort.description: Order: best match (default), cheapest, dearest, newest or biggest price drop

type.description: A product type, e.g. flowers, plants, chocolate, food, drinks, candles, beauty, jewellery, cards, balloons, toys, home; children with a dot ("flowers.dried")

name: search_products
title: Search products across UK stores
